title: BooHoo!!!
text:
BooHoo!!!. What a huge disappointment :(
I opened the box and took this out with glee and joy as I shook it free of it's packaging and saw how beautiful it is~~fluffy and printed on both sides,absolutely the perfect size I was longing for....
Imagine my depth of despair when I plugged it in,spread it out over my armchair,and came back from the kitchen with my tea only to find it DOA.
The plugs were all affixed properly yet the control blinked red and the blankie had no response.
It would be a perfect "throw" considering it's other qualites,but for that price,sayonara my fickle friend..
